title: ModuleTaskCommand
responsibility: Expose task commands and a task serve command that delegates an entire plan to the server-owned executor. Expose safe assignment and priority for queued tasks.

inputs.name: serve
inputs.description: Uses full plan, worker, exact module filter and owned AbortSignal. once invokes exactly one attempt; default watch until interrupted. No separatemanualadd/worker call.

inputs.name: constructor.workerService
inputs.description: Trusted in-process collaborator for worker routing. Omission constructs the real worker when invoked; no CLI, task or environment input controls this collaborator.

inputs.name: priority
inputs.description: Passes the exact task id to ModuleTaskService.prioritize; does not launch a provider.

inputs.name: assign
inputs.description: Passes the exact task id and worker id to ModuleTaskService.assign; does not launch a provider.

outputs.name: register
outputs.description: Registers serve along with existingcommands. Delegates server.run(plan,{worker,modules,once,signal}); serializes actual one-shot result. SIGINT/SIGTERM abort owned signal, awaits server settlement then removes only own listeners. Also registers FeaturePlanCommand under task plan for draft, show, select, approve and start.

outputs.name: worker
outputs.description: Routes parsed worker ID and module filters to the supplied collaborator or the real guarded worker. A failed result sets process exit code 1; owned signal listeners are removed.

outputs.name: priority
outputs.description: Prints the actual repository result returned by the service.

outputs.name: assign
outputs.description: Prints the actual repository result returned by the service.

errors.name: Malformed plan/read/server failure
errors.type: propagated safe CLI failure; no fallback or fake completion

errors.name: Cancellation
errors.type: abort awaited, no detached worker, no success claim

errors.name: Invalid or ineligible priority
errors.type: propagated safe CLI failure without queue mutation

errors.name: Invalid or ineligible assignment
errors.type: propagated safe CLI failure without queue mutation
